title: Getting to know you (first check-in)
description: A first one-on-one: classes, interests, and how the student is settling in.

steps.text: It's nice to meet you, {name}. I'd love to learn a little about you so I can be more helpful.
What classes are you taking this semester?
acks: Thanks! That sounds like a full schedule.

steps.text: What are you studying, or thinking about studying?
What do you like to do for fun?
On a scale of one to five, how settled in do you feel at IU so far?

low.text: Thanks for being honest. What has been the hardest part of the change?
acks: That makes a lot of sense. A lot of first-year students feel that way.

low.text: Your Peer Mentor has been through this too, and they're a great person to talk with about it. I'll let them know you might like to chat.

low.reason: Student rated feeling settled in as low on first check-in.

mid.text: That's really common in the first few weeks. It usually gets easier.

steps.text: Is there anything you're looking forward to this semester?
